title: Ron Cobb
description: RON COBB's popularity was already established as an "underground" cartoonist whose sharp wit and deft pen strokes skewered the pmpous. When he was called upon to romp in George Lucas' playground, he came up with a slew ot bizarre and wondrous alien creatures to populate the Cantina, perhaps the most well-known bar ana hangout in the galaxy. One can only guess what this blue alien with the slit elliptical eyes is thinking.
